newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ValuJet progress slow.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ValuJet progress slow.

text.p: Dillon, Read & Co Inc said ValuJet Inc's return to profitability "is taking longer than we had hoped" due to aggressive pricing competition from major competitors.

-- said, "ValuJet is finding the competitive arena much tougher this time than it was when the company started operations because the network airlines are responding aggressively to any low-fare operations on their route systems."
-- said ValuJet's unit costs should be $0.075 to $0.08 per available seat mile by year-end.
-- said ValuJet's loss in the second quarter is expected to narrow "considerably" from the first quarter and the company may "flirt" with breakeven in the third quarter.
-- said ValuJet's financial position remains solid.
-- said ValuJet's cash drain "appears to have been minimized, so there is no question of financial solvency at present."
-- said continues to rate ValuJet as outperform.
